The discussion also includes bearish signals and a rejected resistance line, reinforcing that the commentary addresses changing market conditions. The Patreon invitation and references to future buying and selling targets are promotional, and the description includes referrals to passive-income and other programs, but the supplied material does not establish a deceptive representation or a benefit dependent on recruitment.
